verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a BSD-2 open-source Python framework (docs-42), and a hands-on probe confirmed it pip-installs and imports with no key (probe-rt-2). The docs say the same bot file is portable across the dev runner, Pipecat Cloud and "most production self-hosting setups" (docs-32), and community reports confirm fully local STT/LLM inference (comm-1, comm-2). The README also notes it can run distributed across processes and machines (gh-1). missing for 10: an in-depth first-party production self-hosting guide (container/Kubernetes deployment, scaling, ops) in the evidence, and hands-on corroboration of a production self-hosted deployment beyond local install.
